diagnostics.message: module.secure_baseline is configured for the organization management account, but has no dependency on aws_organizations_organization.org. Its organization data lookup can run before the organization exists, and its organization analyzers, organization trail and Config aggregator can run before ALL features and trusted service access are enabled. Add depends_on = [aws_organizations_organization.org] to the root module call.

aws_config_configuration_aggregator.organization references only aws_iam_role.config_organization, not aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.config_organization. The organization aggregator must wait for AWSConfigRoleForOrganizations to be attached so Config can retrieve organization details. Add an explicit dependency on the attachment, as in the provider's organization-aggregation example.

aws_cloudtrail.global references the CloudWatch delivery role but does not wait for aws_iam_role_policy.cloudwatch_delivery_policy. Creating/configuring the trail can therefore race installation of logs:CreateLogStream and logs:PutLogEvents permissions, causing CloudWatch Logs authorization failures. Depend on the role policy before enabling delivery.

aws_cloudtrail.global references the SNS topic but does not wait for aws_sns_topic_policy.local-account-cloudtrail to grant cloudtrail.amazonaws.com sns:Publish. Trail creation/start can race the required topic authorization. Reference the policy's topic ARN to order creation after the policy.

data.aws_subnets.default in ap-northeast-1 reads default subnet inventory independently of aws_default_vpc.default. When no default VPC exists, the VPC resource creates it and its default subnets during apply, after this lookup may already have returned an empty set; the subnet-hardening resources then miss those subnets. Order the lookup after the default VPC. An idiomatic implementation is an additional filter block: filter { name = "vpc-id"; values = [aws_default_vpc.default.id] } (use separate HCL lines, not semicolons).

data.aws_subnets.default in ap-northeast-2 should wait for aws_default_vpc.default: if the VPC resource creates a missing default VPC, it also creates default subnets that a plan-time inventory lookup would miss, leaving them unhardened. Add a dependency or a vpc-id filter block referencing aws_default_vpc.default.id.

aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.unauthorized_api_calls enables SNS actions without waiting for aws_sns_topic_policy.alarms to authorize cloudwatch.amazonaws.com. Alarm creation can succeed, but an early ALARM transition can lose its notification while the policy is still pending. Reference the policy's ARN for alarm_actions to order activation after authorization.
